label: Вновь
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вновь (anew, once again).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Literary renewal. 'Вновь' means once again and modifies 'ожил', marking a return to life. It is the bookish, elevated cousin of 'снова', favoured in writing and formal speech.
Strategic focus: Solemn reunion. 'Вновь' modifies 'встретились' to mark a meeting after long separation. The adverb lends a measured, literary tone suited to a weighty reunion.

missions.phrase: Надежда вновь появилась в его сердце.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Renewed feeling. 'Вновь' modifies 'появилась' to show hope returning. Its elevated register fits this poetic, emotional image far better than the casual 'опять'.
Strategic focus: Formal repetition. 'Вновь' modifies 'провели' to mark the experiment being run once more. The adverb suits a neutral, formal scientific register.
Strategic focus: Cyclical bloom. 'Вновь' modifies the perfective 'расцвёл' to mark the garden blooming again. The literary adverb suits this poetic image of seasonal return.

missions.phrase: Он вновь обрёл уверенность в себе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Recovered state. 'Вновь' modifies 'обрёл' to show confidence regained. The pairing with the elevated verb 'обрёл' keeps the whole phrase in a literary register.
Strategic focus: Resumed operation. 'Вновь' modifies 'начал' to mark the factory restarting. The adverb gives a formal, almost reportorial flavour to the renewal.

missions.phrase: Я хочу вновь увидеть это море.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Yearning to repeat. 'Вновь' modifies the infinitive 'увидеть' inside the wish 'хочу', expressing a longing to see the sea again. Its elevated tone deepens the sentiment.
Strategic focus: Reopening. 'Вновь' modifies 'открылся' to mark the theatre opening once more after renovation. The formal adverb fits an announcement-style sentence.
Strategic focus: Restored condition. 'Вновь' modifies 'воцарилась' to show silence settling again. Paired with the lofty verb 'воцарилась', it sustains a distinctly literary register.
